root_cause.text: An off-by-one error in iavf_config_rss_reg() used inclusive `<=` loop bounds with `adapter->rss_key_size / 4` and `adapter->rss_lut_size / 4` even though those values are element counts, causing one past-the-end access to the RSS key/LUT arrays and one extra device register write.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes both loops in `drivers/net/ethernet/intel/iavf/iavf_main.c` from `for (i = 0; i <= adapter->rss_{key,lut}_size / 4; i++)` to `for (i = 0; i < adapter->rss_{key,lut}_size / 4; i++)`, and the commit message explicitly states that `rss_{key,lut}_size / 4` is the number of dwords so the last valid index is `(size / 4) - 1`, with KASAN reporting a read 0 bytes past a 52-byte allocation in `iavf_config_rss`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix off-by-one loop bounds in RSS register programming to avoid overrunning the key and LUT buffers.
intent_record.what: The two for-loops in iavf_config_rss_reg were changed from using '<=' to '<' when iterating up to adapter->rss_key_size / 4 and adapter->rss_lut_size / 4, respectively.
intent_record.how: This prevents each loop from executing one extra iteration and reading/writing past the valid end of the RSS key and LUT arrays, avoiding out-of-bounds access and an extra invalid register write.

vuln_statements.explanation: This loop condition is the root off-by-one error: it uses an inclusive <= bound with a count-derived limit, causing one extra iteration beyond the valid RSS key array element range.

bic_trace_step.reason: The function body is sufficient because it shows the exact loop logic operating on the RSS key and LUT arrays. The vulnerable construct is present in both loops: `for (i = 0; i <= adapter->rss_key_size / 4; i++)` and `for (i = 0; i <= adapter->rss_lut_size / 4; i++)`. Since `adapter->rss_key_size / 4` and `adapter->rss_lut_size / 4` are element counts for the `u32` arrays, using the inclusive bound `<=` causes one extra iteration. That leads to out-of-bounds reads at `dw[i]` in `wr32(hw, I40E_VFQF_HKEY(i), dw[i]);` and `wr32(hw, I40E_VFQF_HLUT(i), dw[i]);`, and also performs one extra register write. The fix would require using an exclusive upper bound such as `< adapter->rss_key_size / 4` and `< adapter->rss_lut_size / 4`, which is not present here.
